categories.main_business_segments: China CITIC Bank operates primarily in three business segments: corporate banking, retail banking, and financial markets business. Corporate banking offers integrated financial solutions including corporate banking, investment banking, international business, transaction banking, custody, and financial markets services. Retail banking provides diversified financial products and services such as wealth management, personal credit, credit cards, private banking, pension finance, and overseas finance. Financial markets business involves bond financing, foreign exchange, precious metals, and asset management services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The Bank leverages advanced financial technologies including AI, blockchain, big data, and Internet of Things to empower business development and risk management. It has independently developed a distributed core banking system and digital platforms such as Smart Online Banking 5.0, Tianyuan Treasury system, Easy Salary payroll platform, and digital wealth advisor 'Xiao Xin'. The Bank also applies AI-powered risk control models and digital customer insight systems to enhance service and operational efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The Bank serves a broad customer base including government and institutional customers, corporate clients, inter-bank market participants, and individual retail customers. Key industries served include manufacturing, real estate, rental and business services, strategic emerging industries, green industries, and small and micro enterprises. The Bank also targets specialized groups such as pension customers, going abroad customers, and Generation Z individuals. Its international business supports Belt and Road partner countries and cross-border trade enterprises.
categories.geographic_coverage: China CITIC Bank operates extensively across mainland China with 1,470 outlets in 153 large and medium-sized cities. It has overseas presence through subsidiaries and branches in Hong Kong SAR, Macao SAR, London, Sydney, New York, Los Angeles, Singapore, Kazakhstan, and other locations. Major regional focuses include the Yangtze River Delta, Bohai Rim, Pearl River Delta and West Strait, Central China, Western China, and Northeastern China.
categories.supply_chain_position: The Bank operates primarily as a downstream financial services provider within the financial supply chain, offering comprehensive banking and financial solutions to end customers including corporations, governments, and individuals. It also plays a role in capital markets and investment banking, facilitating financing and investment activities. Through subsidiaries like CITIC Financial Leasing, it participates in financial leasing, supporting asset acquisition for clients.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the Bank focuses on becoming a leading bank in five areas: wealth management, comprehensive financing, trading settlement, forex services, and digital banking. It prioritizes the Five Priorities in finance: technology finance, green finance, inclusive finance, pension finance, and digital finance. The Bank invests heavily in technology (over RMB10 billion in 2024), advancing AI, blockchain, big data, and digital transformation to enhance customer experience, risk management, and operational efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: The Bank generates revenue primarily through net interest income from loans and deposits, accounting for about 68.8% of operating income. Non-interest income, including fee and commission income, trading gains, investment securities gains, and custody fees, accounts for about 31.2%. Fee income derives from services such as wealth management, credit cards, custody, settlement, and investment banking underwriting. The Bank also earns income from financial market operations and asset management services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: China CITIC Bank is positioned as a major joint-stock commercial bank in China with strong comprehensive strength and brand competitiveness. It ranks 18th among the top 1,000 world banks by tier-one capital and 19th among top 500 banking brands globally. The Bank competes with other large Chinese commercial banks and joint-stock banks, leveraging CITIC Group’s resources and its distinctive 'Five Leading' strategy to differentiate itself in wealth management, comprehensive financing, trading settlement, forex services, and digital banking.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of end 2024, the Bank had total assets of RMB9.53 trillion, loans of RMB5.72 trillion, and deposits of RMB5.78 trillion, reflecting steady growth of 5.31%, 4.03%, and 7.04% respectively over the previous year. Net profit attributable to equity holders was RMB68.58 billion, up 2.33% year-on-year. The Bank maintains strong capital adequacy ratios (13.36% total capital adequacy) and liquidity coverage ratio (218.13%). It serves 145 million retail customers and over 1.26 million corporate customers, with a workforce of over 65,000 employees.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The Bank emphasizes a customer-centric approach with a distinctive and differentiated financial service model under its 'Five Leading' strategy. It offers integrated, customized, and full-lifecycle financial solutions leveraging CITIC Group’s comprehensive resources. Its competitive differentiation lies in its strong synergy within CITIC Group, advanced digital and AI-driven platforms, broad product offerings across corporate and retail segments, and leadership in specialized areas such as technology finance, green finance, inclusive finance, pension finance, and cross-border forex services.
